title: The Lord Has Chosen Zion

questions.question: Remember, O Lord, in David's favor, all the what he endured?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:1 (ESV): "Remember, O Lord, in David's favor, all the hardships he endured,"

questions.question: How he swore to the Lord and vowed to the Mighty One of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:2 (ESV): "...and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,"

questions.question: I will not enter my house or get into my bed, I will not give sleep to my eyes until I find a what for the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:4-5 (ESV): "...until I find a place for the Lord,"

questions.question: A dwelling place for the Mighty One of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:5 (ESV): "a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."

questions.question: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let your saints shout for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:9 (ESV): "...and let your saints shout for joy."

questions.question: For the sake of your servant David, do not turn away the face of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:10 (ESV): "...do not turn away the face of your anointed one."

questions.question: The Lord swore to David a sure oath from which he will not turn back: "One of the sons of your body I will set on your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:11 (ESV): "...I will set on your throne."

questions.question: For the Lord has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:13 (ESV): "...he has desired it for his dwelling place:"

questions.question: I will abundantly bless her provisions; I will satisfy her poor with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:15 (ESV): "I will satisfy her poor with bread."

questions.question: Her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her saints will shout for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:16 (ESV): "and her saints will shout for joy."

questions.question: There I will make a horn to sprout for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:17 (ESV): "There I will make a horn to sprout for David;"

questions.question: I have prepared a lamp for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:17 (ESV): "I have prepared a lamp for my anointed."

questions.question: His enemies I will clothe with shame, but on him his crown will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:18 (ESV): "...but on him his crown will shine."

questions.question: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:6 (ESV): "...we found it in the fields of Jaar."

questions.question: Arise, O Lord, and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 132:8 (ESV): "...you and the ark of your might."

key_verse_text: The Lord swore to David a sure oath from which he will not turn back: "One of the sons of your body I will set on your throne."
